observations.contract: Identical pixel format and explicit extent
observations.trace: convert_pixels computes width*height then, if source and destination formats match, copies the smaller buffer length and returns Ok before any extent-size check. PixelFormat::bytes_per_pixel returns4 for Rgba8Unorm. A hypothetical 1x1 RGBA image with empty source and destination therefore reaches Ok without four bytes of either storage. Nonidentity packed conversions check at least width*height*4.
observations.remaining: Original Adler355 and queue147 identified the same-format admission gap. No image, buffer copy, multiplication or conversion ran. Textual repository search found only the definition and in-file test call; external callers and overflow policies remain open. Suffix handling for longer buffers is a separate explicit policy question.

observations.trace: ColorPrimaries is public and serde-capable. For hypothetical identical red, green and blue chromaticities (0.25,0.25) with an enumerated white point, the primary columns are identical and the basis is singular. invert_3x3 returns None for a zero determinant, but to_xyz_matrix substitutes identity for the primary inverse and from_xyz_matrix substitutes identity for its inverse. ColorTransform::new returns a transform directly; ConversionError includes SingularMatrix but that constructor does not return it.
observations.remaining: Original Adler356 and queue148 identified the inversion admission issue. This is source and symbolic rank reasoning, not an executed matrix or color conversion. Valid standard spaces, custom-primary policies, nonfinite inputs and error propagation remain open. ACES2065-1 explicitly has a negative blue y coordinate, so a blanket positive-coordinate rule would exclude a listed standard.

observations.trace: Original Lens3 queue3145 already recorded the exact 1x1 I420 example and had later same-lens e275 source receipts. Current convert_pixels computes chroma_len=floor(width*height/4), admits source1/destination4 for a 1x1 I420 image, slices empty U and V planes, then i420_to_rgba8 uses ceil(width/2) and indexes each plane at0. Separately, for a hypothetical 2x1 NV12 image, the wrapper accepts one UV byte but nv12_to_rgba8 reads UV indices0 and1; the RGBA-to-NV12 wrapper likewise accepts a one-byte UV suffix while its encoder writes two bytes. ChromaSubsampling::chroma_dimensions uses ceiling on both axes for 4:2:0.
observations.remaining: The I420 example is the original Lens3 finding, not a new unique defect; e275 receipts and current source are separately bound by exact Git proofs. Adler355 also left odd-plane contracts pending. No buffer, image, index, panic, arithmetic, conversion or test ran. Supported odd dimensions, interleaved row stride, exact native callers and additional aliases remain open. Earlier e275 current-scope qualification reused earlier same-lens reads with zero fresh personal rereads.

observations.trace: ColorSpace::to_linear_space claims to return a linear-light variant. Its wildcard returns DciP3 and AdobeRgb unchanged, while their transfer_function results are Dci and Gamma22 rather than Linear. The enum has no separate linear DCI-P3 or linear Adobe RGB variant; ACES variants already have linear transfer.
observations.remaining: Adler356 previously identified this mapping as an unresolved contract, and the current static enum trace supplies its concrete branches. Textual repository search found no call beyond the method definition, but external callers and the intended unsupported-mode policy remain open. No enum method or color conversion ran; the remedy must retain primaries/white point rather than silently choose a different space.

observations.trace: Several nonidentity RGBA/BGRA conversions check a minimum byte count for width*height, then iterate over all paired four-byte chunks of the supplied slices. The same-format path copies the shorter whole slice. R8 expansion instead bounds source iteration to num_pixels. Transfer functions intentionally distinguish HDR and normalization policies.
observations.remaining: Whether larger supplied slice suffixes are part of the image or must remain untouched is unresolved; no separate suffix defect is asserted. Raw HDR/negative values, transfer limits and native color consumers require independent policy and source review.
